items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Big George Williams. Yeah. I hear him in the street with Big George. [INTERVIEWEE] Big George Williams, eh? Yeah.

ctx.x: He said, who you played with before you played with Jack? Let's see. What's that with Jack? I had a kind of a big role in Robichaud's, John Robichaud's band. So that means- And then, you know, John Robichaud had a Spanish band, good, you know. And he used to play for all the rich white people. And now and then he would play for the college when they had a tag. And so, he kind of went down during the length. So his drummer, I was playing with his drummer. There was four or five piece band, Walter Blunder. You got…
Big George Williams. Yeah. I hear him in the street with Big George.
